entry.title: Seven-country study finds universities at very different stages of AI readiness
entry.summary:
Ucwaningo olwenziwe emazweni ayisikhombisa yiWISE kanye neInstitute of International Education luthola ukuthi amanyuvesi asezigabeni ezihluke kakhulu zokulungela i-AI ekhiqizayo, kuyilapho inqubomgomo, izimo zengqondo zabafundi kanye nengqalasizinda konke kungalingani. Enyuvesi ezimele yaseGhana, amaphesenti angu-64 othisha abika ukuthi banenqubomgomo ye-AI ecacile, kuyilapho kumanyuvesi kahulumeni ocwaningo kungamaphesenti angu-27, nakuba amaphesenti angu-89 othisha kulolu cwaningo asebenzisa i-AI ngokwabo ngaphambili. Abacwaningi baxwayisa ukuthi, njengoba amamodeli e-AI aholayo afundiswa ikakhulukazi ngesiNgisi nezimiso zolimi ezibusa, izikhungo zase-Afrika namanye amazwe aseNingizimu Yomhlaba zisengozini yokuhlala zisebenzisa i-AI kuphela, hhayi ukuyakha.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngesinsika ka-Wits AHEAD mayelana ne-AI enokuzibophezela, ukuziphatha, ubulungiswa kanye nenqubomgomo, lolu cwaningo lukhombisa ukuthi igebe lokulungela phakathi kwezikhungo, hhayi phakathi kwamazwe kuphela, lingakhulisa kunokuncipha ukungalingani endleleni imfundo ephakeme esebenzisa ngayo i-AI.

WISE and the Institute of International Education (IIE), reported by University World News · Established higher education press, reporting a WISE/IIE policy brief

entry.title: Dutch minister calls AI-written theses 'fraud', universities say detection scores cannot prove it
entry.summary:
Ukuhlolwa okwenziwe inethiwekhi yokusakaza yaseNetherlands emaphepheni ocwaningo amaningi abafundi be-master kumanyuvesi ayishumi nambili kuthole ukuthi engxenyeni eyodwa kwezinhlanu, izinhlelo zokuxoxisana njengeChatGPT, iClaude noma iGemini zibhale ingxenye enkulu yombhalo kunomfundi uqobo. UNgqongqoshe Wezemfundo, uRianne Letschert, uthi lokhu kuyinkohliso, kodwa inhlangano emele amanyuvesi aseNetherlands, iUniversiteiten van Nederland, ithi iphuzu lokuhlonza lodwa alikwazi ukufakazela ukona, nokuthi umbuzo ngempela umayelana nendlela amasethingi okuhlolwa enziwa ngayo. AmaNyuvesi aseDelft, aseUtrecht nase Leiden avimbe noma enqabele ukusetshenziswa kwamathuluzi okuhlonza i-AI emisebenzini yabafundi, ethi awethembekile.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngesinsika ka-Wits AHEAD mayelana ne-AI ekhiqizayo emfundweni ephakeme, lo mbango ukhombisa ukuthi ingxabano yobuqotho basezifundweni ingaphenduka kabi ngenhliziyo yezombusazwe uma uNgqongqoshe engenela, futhi kungani leli qembu likhuthaza ukuhleleka kabusha kokuhlolwa esikhundleni sokwethembela kusofthiwe lokuhlonza.

Times Higher Education · Established higher education press

entry.title: Russell Group students say they are taught little about AI, Bett UK survey finds
entry.summary:
Ucwaningo lwe-Bett UK kubafundi beziqu zokuqala abangaphezu kuka-1,000 e-UK luthola ukuthi amaphesenti angu-77 abafundi emanyuvesi e-Russell Group athi afundiswa okuncane noma lutho nge-AI, kuyilapho emanyuvesi angemuva kuka-1992 kungamaphesenti angu-64. Lolu cwaningo lufumene nokuthi amaphesenti angu-78 abafundi angathanda iziqu eziphathelene nobuchwepheshe obuhlanganisa umuntu ngamunye futhi ezithatha isikhathi esincane, kuyilapho amaphesenti angu-34 kuphela azizwa enyuvesi yabo yethembeke kubo mayelana nemiphumela yangempela yabathweswe iziqu. I-Russell Group ithi amalungu ayo asesakha kabusha izifundo kanye nemithetho yokuhlola ngenxa yalokhu.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngesinsika ka-Wits AHEAD mayelana ne-AI ekhiqizayo emfundweni ephakeme, ukutholakala kokuthi amanyuvesi agxile kucwaningo afundisa amakhono e-AI kancane kunemikhungo eyinye kuvusa umbuzo weqiniso wobulungiswa: yibo bani abathweswe iziqu abangena belungiselelwe emsakazweni womsebenzi oguqulwe yi-AI.

Times Higher Education · Established higher education press

entry.title: New framework guides statistics and data science educators on teaching responsible generative AI use
entry.summary:
Ithimba lothisha bezibalo kanye nesayensi yedatha likhiphe uhlaka olunezigaba ezine, ukuqonda, intuthuko, umbiko kanye nokuphepha, ukuqondisa indlela othisha abafundisa abafundi ukusebenzisa amathuluzi e-AI ekhiqizayo ngokuzibophezela kuhlelo lwekhodi nokuhlaziya kwezibalo. Lithuthukiswe ngama-workshop nokuphawula kwabafundi, selisetshenziswe kakade ku-MOOC kanye nokufundisa kwabafundi bokuqala nabaziqu eziphakeme.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Insika 3, i-AI nokuhlaziywa kwedatha kwimfundo ye-STEM nemfundo yothisha, idinga uhlaka olusebenza ekilasini masinyane, hhayi izitatimende zenqubomgomo kuphela; lokhu kunika i-Wits AHEAD isibonelo esisebenzayo sokufundisa ukwazi kahle nge-AI ekhiqizayo ngaphakathi kwesayensi yezibalo.

arXiv · Preprint (not yet peer-reviewed)

entry.title: New tool scrambles assignment images so AI reading systems fail, but people can still read them
entry.summary:
Abacwaningi bakhe i-AIRRI, ithuluzi elishintsha izithombe zomsebenzi oshicilelwe ngokuguqula isikhala, ukuzivela nomsindo wezithombe kuhlanganiswe nokuhlasela okuphikisanayo, ukuze amathuluzi oku-OCR namachatbots e-AI akuthole kunzima ukubhala kabusha umbhalo kodwa umuntu olesayo asakwazi ukufunda kahle. Ihlolwe kumasistimu amathathu okufunda, ukuhlasela okunamandla kakhulu kwenza amaphesenti amaphutha wezinhlamvu esistimu enye enyuka kusuka ku-2.3% kuya ku-100%, kanti amaphesenti amaphutha amagama kwesistimu enye enyuka kusuka ku-24.9% kuya ku-96.7%. Ithimba liphinde lakhipha idatha yomsebenzi wemfundo ephakeme ukuhlola indlela.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Insika 1, i-AI ekhiqizayo kwimfundo ephakeme: ukufundisa, ukuhlola, kanye nobuqotho, idinga izivikelo ezisebenza esigabeni somsebenzi uqobo; i-Wits AHEAD ibukele amathuluzi afana nalesi ukubona ukuthi ubuqotho bungakha yini kuzinsiza zekhosi, kunokulandelwa kamuva.

arXiv · Preprint (not yet peer-reviewed)

entry.title: New framework argues the cost of AI essay-marking systems should be measured against trustworthy scores, not efficiency alone
entry.summary:
Iphepha elisha liphakamisa uhlaka “Okuklanyiwe Kokulinganisa Okunakekela Izindleko” lwamasistimu wokunikeza amamaki emibhalo ngokuzenzakalela, lithi izindleko zekhompyutha zokulinganisa nge-AI zivame ukuphathwa njengodaba nje lokusebenza kahle kwezobuchwepheshe, kodwa ngempela kuyinqumo yokuklama ukulinganisa. Uhlaka luchaza “izindleko ngamaki angenakuphikiswa” elinganisela amasistimu wokunikeza amamaki kuphela phakathi kokuklanyiwe okufeza izinga eliphansi lokulinganisa okwethembekile, futhi liphatha amandla okuphatha kanye nokugadwa kwesikhungo njengomkhawulo wokuklanyiwe okungasetshenziswa nhlobo, kunokuba izindleko ezidingeka zincishiswe.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kwinsika ka-Wits AHEAD ye-AI ekhiqizayo kwimfundo ephakeme, ukufundisa, ukuhlola kanye nobuqotho, uhlaka lunikeza amanyuvesi acabangela ukusebenzisa ukunikeza amamaki ngosizo lwe-AI indlela eqondile yokubuza ukuthi ingabe isistimu eshibhile ikhiqiza ngempela amamaki angenakuphikiswa, kunokuba amathuluzi okuhlolwa okuzenzakalelayo ahlulelwe ngesivinini nezindleko kuphela.

entry.title: Study of a South African university finds online “participation profiles” mostly track how long a learner is observed, not how engaged they are
entry.summary:
Ngokuhlaziya amarekhodi abafundi-amakhono angu-16,448 kubafundi abangu-4,599 kumakhosi angu-152 enyuvesi kahulumeni yaseNingizimu Afrika, abacwaningi bahlola izilinganiso eziyisishiyagalombili ezivame ukusetshenziselwa “ukubamba iqhaza” ku-inthanethi, bathola ukuthi zonke zabonisa ngamandla kakhulu isikhathi umfundi aqashwa ngaso esifundweni kunokubamba iqhaza kwakhe ngempela. Ngemuva kokulungisa lo mphumela, isethi encane yezilinganiso isabahlukanisa abafundi ngephethini ebanzi yezithombe ezimbili kanye nephethini eningiliziwe yezithombe ezine, kodwa ngokuzethemba okulinganiselayo kuphela.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kwinsika ka-Wits AHEAD ye-AI kanye nokuhlaziya kwedatha okubikezelayo kwimpumelelo yabafundi, ukutholakala kusiyisexwayiso esiqondile samasistimu wesexwayiso sangaphambili kanye nokugcinwa kwabafundi akhiwe ngedatha yaseNingizimu Afrika: ngaphandle kokuba isikhathi umfundi aqashwa ngaso sibalwa, isithombe esiphawulwe ngokuthi “asihlanganyeli” singaba ngumfundi nje obukelwe isikhathi esincane, kungesi ngempela esisengcupheni.

entry.title: Study finds students who earn the same grade can have done very different amounts of their own thinking with AI help
entry.summary:
Ngokuhlaziya ingxoxo ezirekhodiwe ezingu-150 phakathi kwabafundi kanye namathuluzi e-AI ekhiqizayo, ucwaningo olusha luthola ukuthi abafundi abaqondisa i-AI, bahlanganise umphumela wayo ngokubhekisisa, futhi bawuhlole ngokucophelela, bangathola amaki afanayo nabafundi abavumela i-AI yenze ingxenye enkulu yokucabanga egameni labo, ngakho amaki ekugcina kuphela awabonisi ukuthi yimalini yomsebenzi eyeyomfundi ngempela. Umbhali ubiza leli gebe ngokuthi “ubunini bolwazi” uthi ukunikeza amaki ngokusekelwe kuphela emphumeleni kungase kuvuze amazinga ahlukene kakhulu okubamba iqhaza kwabafundi ngamaki afanayo.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kwinsika ka-Wits AHEAD ye-AI ekhiqizayo kwimfundo ephakeme, ukufundisa, ukuhlola kanye nobuqotho, ucwaningo luqinisa impikiswano yokuhlola okubheka nendlela umfundi asebenzise ngayo i-AI phakathi nomsebenzi, hhayi umkhiqizo osuphelele kuphela, ngoba amaki amabili afanayo angafihla ukufunda okwahlukene kakhulu.

entry.title: Wits tells top applicants AI should make graduates indispensable, not just employable
entry.summary:
Abafundi abaphumelele kakhulu abangaphezu kuka-200, abavela eGauteng nakwezinye izifundazwe, bahambele uMcimbi WoShansela WaseWits Wabafundi Abaphumelele Kakhulu, lapho umfundi wakudala waseWits, uDkt Craig Wing, enikeza inkulumo enkulu mayelana ne-AI kanye nekusasa lomhlaba womsebenzi. IPhini likaShansela, uSolwazi Garth Stevens, watshela abafundi ukuthi ukufunda enyuvesi kungumthwalo wemfanelo hhayi nje indlela eya emsebenzini, futhi ukuthi iWits ifuna abathweswe iziqu bayo babe ngabangaphezu kokuqashekayo, ifuna babe abangenakuswelwa.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngokuqondene nensika ka-Wits AHEAD ye-AI, ikhono labathweswe iziqu, ukuqasheka kanye nokuguqulwa okunobulungiswa, lo mcimbi ukhombisa ukuthi inyuvesi uqobo ilungiselela abafundi abasha ukuqondiswa yisimakethe yomsebenzi eguqulwe yi-AI kusukela osukwini lwabo lokuqala eWits, kunokuyekela umbuzo wokuqasheka kube ngemuva kokuthweswa iziqu.

Wits University · University announcement

entry.title: Study finds AI grading tools miss most student misconceptions despite accurate scores
entry.summary:
Ucwaningo olusha luphenye ukuthi amamodeli amakhulu olimi asebenzisa i-AI ukulinganisela imisebenzi evulekile kwimfundo ephakeme ayiwusizo njengoba kubonakala emaphesentini okunemba kwawo. Ngokuhlaziya izimpendulo zabafundi ezingu-3,041 kumibuzo evulekile engu-50 yesayensi yekhompyutha, elinganiswe othisha babantu kanye namamodeli amakhulu olimi amathathu angokwezohwebo, abacwaningi bathola ukuthi impendulo evela ku-AI yabonakalisa ukungaqondakali kwabafundi emaphesentini ayi-5 kuya ku-7 kuphela, uma kuqhathaniswa namaphesenti ayi-15 kuya ku-31 kothisha babantu, futhi impendulo ye-AI yahlala ilungile kuphela kungakhathaliseki izinga lempendulo. Ucwaningo luphinde lwathola ukuthi amamaki amancane e-rubric avela ku-AI ayihlobene kakhulu yomunye nomunye kangangoba awanikezi ulwazi oluncane oluzimele lokuxilonga.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kwinsika ka-Wits AHEAD ye-AI ekhiqizayo kwimfundo ephakeme, ukufundisa, ukuhlola kanye nobuqotho, ukutholakala kokuthi ukulinganisa nge-AI kungabonakala kunembile kuyilapho kushiya iphutha eliningi lokucabanga elibalulekile ekufundiseni, kuyisexwayiso sokungathathi ukulinganisa okuzenzakalelayo njengesibonelo sokwahlulela kothisha.

entry.title: California requires its public colleges to set AI procurement and training standards
entry.summary:
I-California isayine umthetho we-Assembly Bill 2392 (AB 2392), ophoqa amanye amasistimu ayo, iCalifornia Community Colleges kanye neCalifornia State University, ukuba ahlanganyele ukwakha iqembu lokusebenza elizonikeza iziphakamiso mayelana nezindinganiso zokuthenga kanye nokuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi nabafundi ngohlelo lwe-AI ekhiqizayo, lapho iziphakamiso kulindeleke ukuba zifike ngoJanuwari 2028. Lo mthetho owasayinwa ngomhla ka-30 Septemba 2026 njenge-Chapter 855 ye-Statutes of 2026, uphinde uphoqe la masistimu amabili ukuba abuyekeze ukuqeqeshwa nge-AI okungenani kanye ngonyaka futhi abike kuShayamthetho wesifundazwe ezinsukwini ezingu-60 ngemuva kokusayina noma yisiphi isivumelwano se-AI ekhiqizayo esisebenza kuso sonke isistimu.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngesinsika sakwa-Wits AHEAD esigxile ku-AI enokuzibophezela, imikhuba ethembekile, ukulingana nenqubomgomo, isinyathelo seCalifornia sokubeka izindinganiso zokuthenga okusemthethweni kanye nokuqeqeshwa emthethweni, kunokuba kushiywe ezikhungweni ngazinye ukuthatha izinqumo ezimayelana nokusetshenziswa kwe-AI ekhiqizayo, kungumzekelo wamazwe asenyakatho yomhlaba wokulawulwa kwe-AI esezingeni lesistimu, into eyamazwe aseNingizimu Yomhlaba ekhuthazwa nawo ukuyakha.

California State Legislature · State legislation

entry.title: University of Johannesburg vice-chancellor: Africa needs AI governance beyond regulation
entry.summary:
Kungxoxo yesiteshi se-CNBC Africa, iPhini likaShansela we-University of Johannesburg, uSolwazi Letlhokwa Mpedi, uxoxile nomhleli omkhulu wesiteshi, Godfrey Mutizwa, mayelana nalokho okudingekayo ukuthi i-Afrika ilawule ubuhlakani bokwenziwa (i-AI) ngale kokuyilawula nje kuphela. Ingxoxo ihlanganisa indima ekufanele idlalwe ngamanyuvesi nangabenza izinqubomgomo ekubumbeni ukuthuthuka kwe-AI ezwekazini, kunokuba balandele kuphela imithetho eyakhiwe kwenye indawo.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kusisika sika-Wits AHEAD mayelana ne-AI enokuzibophezela, imikhuba, ukulingana nenqubomgomo, iPhini likaShansela lenyuvesi yaseNingizimu Afrika elikhuluma ngokubusa kwe-AI okuholwa yi-Afrika likhuluma ngqo nombono ka-Wits AHEAD wokwakha amandla ase-Afrika okubeka imibandela yokuthuthuka kwe-AI, kunokuba ivumelane nje nohlaka olwakhiwe kwenye indawo.

CNBC Africa · Broadcast interview, major African business channel

entry.title: Joining up AI across recruitment, retention and alumni relations can close graduation gaps, if it is governed well
entry.summary:
Ebhala ku-University World News, umqondisi wephrojekthi ye-IREX, uCameron Mirza, uthi amanyuvesi kufanele aphathe ukuqashwa kwabafundi, ukubagcina kanye nobudlelwane nabathweswe iziqu njengesigaba esisodwa esixhumene, esisekelwa yi-AI, kunokuba kube izinhlelo ezahlukene ezinedatha ehlukene. Ucaphuna uhlelo lwe-chatbot nokuhlaziywa kwedatha okubikezelayo lwe-Georgia State University, oluncomeka ngokuncishisa "ukuphela kwabafundi ehlobo" ngamaphesenti angaba ngu-21 nangokusiza abafundi abaMnyama, abangama-Hispanic, abokuqala emindenini yabo ukuya enyuvesi kanye nabampofu ukuba bathweswe iziqu ngezinga elilingana noma eledlula elabanye bonke abafundi, kuyilapho exwayisa ukuthi amamodeli aqeqeshwe ngedatha yangaphambili nawo angaqinisa ukungalingani abekelwe ukuwaxazulula.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngesinsika sika-Wits AHEAD mayelana ne-AI nokuhlaziywa kwedatha okubikezelayo kwempumelelo yabafundi, lesi sihloko siyisikhumbuzo esibalulekile sokuthi amathuluzi esexwayiso sangaphambili nokugcinwa kwabafundi avala kuphela igebe lobulungiswa uma ehambisana nokuqashwa kombono womuntu kanye nokuhlolwa kokuchema, okuyimbuzo yokulawulwa uWits AHEAD ayibuza kunoma yiliphi ithuluzi lokuhlaziya idatha aliphakamisayo.

University World News · Established higher education press (commentary by a sector practitioner)

entry.title: Wits researchers argue Africa must set its own AI research agenda, not just apply others' tools
entry.summary:
Izazi zekhompuyutha ezimbili ze-University of the Witwatersrand, uBenjamin Rosman noSteve James, abangabaqondisi abahlanganyela be-Robotics, Autonomous Intelligence and Learning (RAIL) Lab, bathi i-Afrika kufanele iqhube ucwaningo lobuhlakani bokwenziwa (i-AI) hhayi nje ukusebenzisa amathuluzi akhiqizwe kwenye indawo. Babhekisa ku-Deep Learning Indaba, manje esesikhulu kunazo zonke isikole sasehlobo se-AI emhlabeni, esaheha ababambiqhaza abangu-1,300 emhlanganweni wanonyaka odlule eKigali, nolugijima uhlelo lwalo i-IndabaX emazweni angu-48 kwangu-54 ase-Afrika kulo nyaka, naku-Machine Intelligence and Neural Discovery (MIND) Institute entsha yaseWits, ehlanganisa abafundisi abacwaningi abangaba ngu-65 emikhakheni yezinto zekhompuyutha, i-neuroscience, i-psychology nenqubomgomo.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngesinsika sika-Wits AHEAD mayelana ne-AI enokuzibophezela, ukuziphatha okulungile, ubulungiswa nenqubomgomo, isixwayiso sokuthi i-Afrika ingagcini isiyindawo nje "yabanye ukuba benze isayensi" sithinta ngqo umgomo ka-Wits AHEAD wokwakha ikhono eliholwa yi-Afrika lokubeka imibuzo yocwaningo lwe-AI, hhayi nje ukusebenzisa amathuluzi e-AI aklanywe kwenye indawo.

Times Higher Education · Established higher education press

entry.title: Study of students in China, Japan and Mongolia finds access to generative AI does not guarantee it is useful for learning
entry.summary:
Iphepha lomsebenzi elicwaninga abafundi abangu-42 abasafunda iziqu zokuqala enyuvesi eyodwa yileyo naleyo e-China, e-Japan nase-Mongolia, lithole ukuthi indlela abafundi abafinyelela ngayo ku-AI ekhiqizayo, ngqo, ngama-platform omhlaba wonke, noma ngokushintsha ulimi, iyinto emisa ukuthi ingabasiza ngempela yini, hhayi nje ukuthi bangakwazi yini ukuyifinyelela. Abafundi baseMongolia, ngokwesibonelo, babevame ukushintshela kolimi lwesiNgisi uma imiphumela ngolimi lwaseMongolia ingasheshi. Wonke amaqembu amathathu abeka esikalini ukunemba, ubumfihlo, ukuncika kanye nomthelela walelo thuluzi ekucabangeni kwawo okujulile. Ababhali, uMing Li, uQin Xie, uAriunaa Enkhtur, uLilan Chen noFei Cheng, baphetha ngokuthi ukufinyelela kwezobuchwepheshe kuphela akuqinisekisi ukusetshenziswa okulinganayo kwezemfundo ezimweni ezahlukene zolimi nobuchwepheshe.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngesinsika sika-Wits AHEAD mayelana ne-AI ekhiqizayo emfundweni ephakeme, okutholakele kokuthi ulimi nezimo zobuchwepheshe zasendaweni, hhayi ukuxhumana kuphela, yikho okunquma ukuthi i-AI ekhiqizayo iyabasiza ngempela yini abafundi ekufundeni kuyisexwayiso uWits AHEAD asisebenzisa ngokulinganayo kumathuluzi e-AI abuswa yisiNgisi asetshenziswa emakhampasini amaningi olimi aseNingizimu Afrika.

entry.title: South African minister tells universities to move from AI debate to decisions on teaching and research
entry.summary:
Ekhuluma eNgqungqutheleni yesine ye-Universities South Africa Higher Education Conference ngomhla ziyi-7 kuMfumfu wezi-2026, uNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo ePhakeme nokuQeqeshwa, Buti Manamela, utshele amanyuvesi ukuthi ubuhlakani bokwenziwa (i-AI) kwenza umsebenzi wawo wokuqeqesha abafundi ukucabanga ngokujulile nokuthwala umthwalo wemfanelo wolwazi ube ngumsebenzi obaluleke nakakhulu, hhayi ngokuncipha, ngoba izinhlelo ze-AI zingakwazi ukukhiqiza okuqukethwe okuzethembayo ngaphandle kokuhlola ukuthi kuliqiniso yini. Uthe umbuzo wangempela awumi ekutheni abafundi basebenzisa i-AI emisebenzini yabo yesikole kuphela, kodwa usukela kubani owakha le tekhnoloji, yiluzimi oluphi namaphi amava ekubhekisela kuwo, ngubani olawula ingqalasizinda kanye nobani ozuzayo; wacela izifundo zobuntu nezenhlalo ukuthi zisebenzisane nobunjiniyela kanye nezesayensi yemvelo ekubhekaneni nokusontela, amandla kanye nemithelela yemisebenzi kulezi zinhlelo.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngesinsika ka-Wits AHEAD mayelana ne-AI ekhiqizayo kwimfundo ephakeme, uNgqongqoshe wekhabhinethi obeka uhlelo oluqondile, mayelana nokufundisa, ukuhlolwa kanye namandla ocwaningo kunokuba yimpikiswano yodwa, unikeza amanyuvesi aseNingizimu Afrika igunya elicacile lokuthi asebenze ngalo.

South African Government News Agency (SAnews) · National government news agency

entry.title: UNESCO study finds 87% of Latin American and Caribbean universities already use AI, but only 26% have a formal strategy
entry.summary:
Iphepha lomsebenzi le-UNESCO IESALC nel-UNU-IAS, elenza ucwaningo emanyuvesi angu-200 emazweni angu-19 ase-Latin America naseCaribbean phakathi kuka-Agasti no-Okthoba wezi-2025, lithole ukuthi amaphesenti angu-87 asesebenzisa i-AI kungxenye ethize eyodwa, ikakhulukazi ekufundiseni nasekufundeni (amaphesenti angu-74) kanye nocwaningweni (amaphesenti angu-57), kodwa amaphesenti angu-26 kuphela anesu elisemthethweni le-AI, kanti amaphesenti angu-55 awanabhajethi oqondene ne-AI nhlobo. Ukusetshenziswa nokulawulwa kokubili kulandela uhlobo lwesikhungo ngokuseduze: amaphesenti angu-84 amanyuvesi azimele angenzi inzuzo asebenzisa i-AI, kuyilapho kumanyuvesi kahulumeni kungamaphesenti angu-68; kanti amaphesenti angu-17 amanyuvesi kahulumeni awabiki ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi nhlobo, kuyilapho kumanyuvesi azimele angenzi inzuzo kuyimaphesenti amathathu kuphela.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngesinsika ka-Wits AHEAD mayelana ne-AI enokuzibophezela, ukuziphatha, ubulungiswa kanye nenqubomgomo, ukutholakala kokuthi ukusetshenziswa kwe-AI kusesakazeke kakhulu kuyilapho ukulawulwa okusemthethweni kusalele kude ngemuva, futhi ngokungalingani phakathi kwemikhungo kahulumeni neyazimele, kufana negebe lokulawula uWits AHEAD alibonayo emazweni wonke aseNingizimu Yomhlaba.

UNESCO IESALC and UNU-IAS, reported by Times Higher Education · Established higher education press, reporting a UNESCO/UNU-IAS working paper

entry.title: UTeach survey finds STEM teacher-training staff cautiously optimistic about AI but wary of integrity and bias risks
entry.summary:
Ucwaningo olwenziwe kubasebenzi abangu-57 abaqeqeshayo, abaphathi kanye nabasebenzi abasuka ezinhlelweni ezingu-31 zokuqeqesha othisha be-STEM bamabanga aphakeme emanyuvesi, ezikweleta kuma-54 amakolishi namanyuvesi e-United States, kuthole ukuthi amaphesenti angu-77 avumelana nokuthi i-AI inamandla okuthinta kahle umsebenzi wawo, kanti amaphesenti angu-61 azibiza ngokuthi asebenzisa i-AI ngokuzimisela. Amaphesenti angu-63 asesaba izinselelo, ikakhulukazi ubuqotho bezifundo (amaphesenti angu-42) kanye nokusontela kokuziphatha (amaphesenti angu-21), kuyilapho amaphesenti angu-70 ebona isidingo sokuqeqeshwa okwengeziwe; amaphesenti angu-79 othisha asebenzisa kakade i-AI ezifundweni zabo, ikakhulukazi ekuhleleni izifundo nasekuklanyeni ukuhlolwa, kunokuyisebenzisa kokuphenya kwe-STEM okugcwele idatha.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngesinsika ka-Wits AHEAD mayelana ne-AI nokuhlaziywa kwedatha kwi-STEM nemfundo yothisha, igebe eliphakathi kwabasebenzi abasebenzisa kakade i-AI nohlaka olwakhelwe ocwaningweni abathi balwentula, luyilona hlobo lokuqondiswa oluhlelekile izinhlelo zokuqeqesha othisha emazweni wonke aseNingizimu Yomhlaba azodinga nazo.

The UTeach Institute, The University of Texas at Austin · University research institute report

entry.title: Systematic review finds no existing framework yet addresses the ethical and instructional challenges of AI in STEM teaching
entry.summary:
Ucwaningo oluhlelekile olwenziwe ngabacwaningi base-Wentworth Institute of Technology kanye ne-University of New Haven luhlole izinhlaka ezisasetshenziswa njenge-TPACK, i-SAMR, i-ADDIE kanye ne-Universal Design for Learning, kuqhathaniswa namamodeli okwazi i-AI kanye nemigomo ye-AI enokuzibophezela, ukuthi ngempela asiza kangakanani othisha be-STEM emsebenzini wabo wokufundisa. Luthole ukuthi akukho nelilodwa kulezi zinhlaka oselibhekene ngempumelelo nezinselelo zomsebenzi, zokuziphatha kanye nezokufundisa ezivela ekusebenziseni i-AI kwimfundo ye-STEM, nokuthi ukusetshenziswa kwamathuluzi e-AI kuphumelela ngesivinini esedlula ukuqondiswa okuhlelekile kwezifundo, kukhiqiza indlela yokusebenza eqondiswa amathuluzi kunokuqondiswa uhlaka.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngesinsika ka-Wits AHEAD mayelana ne-AI nokuhlaziywa kwedatha kwi-STEM nemfundo yothisha, ukutholakala kokuthi akukho uhlaka lokufundisa olukhona manje olubhekene nezinselelo zokuziphatha nezokufundisa ze-AI, kuqinisa isizathu seqembu sokwenza umsebenzi walo wokuhlanganisa i-AI enokuzibophezela eqondene ne-STEM.

American Society for Engineering Education (ASEE), North East Section Conference · Peer-reviewed conference paper

entry.title: More universities end Turnitin contracts as concerns mount
entry.summary:
I-Times Higher Education ibika ukuthi iNewcastle University kanye ne-University of Westminster zihlanganise ne-University of Southampton ekuqedeni izinqumo zazo ne-Turnitin, inkampani yokuthola ukukopela, emva kokuba iTurnitin iphakamise izinguquko zelayisensi ezingase zivumele ukuthi umsebenzi wabafundi osekilasini usetshenziselwe ukuqeqesha amathuluzi e-AI. INewcastle ibeke kugcizelela leli vesi mayelana nedatha; iWestminster ithe isihloli sokukopela se-Turnitin 'asisebenzi kahle' kumbhalo obhalwe yi-AI, futhi isihloli sayo se-AI 'sinobungozi obuvunyelwene bokuphumela kungamanga'. INyuvesi yaseSouthampton yodwa ikhokhele iTurnitin amaponti angu-87,621 ngonyaka owodwa, kubafundi abangaphezu kuka-17,000 besemabangeni aphansi nabangu-8,000 beziqu eziphakeme.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kwinsika ka-Wits AHEAD ephathelene ne-AI enokuzibophezela, ukuziphatha okulungile, ukulingana nenqubomgomo, lo mbango ukhombisa amanyuvesi eqala ukulinganisa ukubusa kwedatha kanye nokwethembeka kwangempela kwamathuluzi okuthola i-AI nezindleko, kunokubheka isinqumo sokuhlola ukukopela njengesidingo esingenakuguquka.

Times Higher Education · Established higher education press

entry.title: Prepare students for post-graduation AI judgement challenges
entry.summary:
I-University World News ithi impendulo yemfundo ephakeme ku-AI ekhiqizayo iyama ngaphambi kwesikhathi, ekuphotulweni kweziqu, kodwa isivivinyo sangempela sokwahlulela kochwepheshe sifika emva kwalokho. Icaphuna ucwaningo olubhaliswe kusengaphambili lwango-2026 olwashicilelwa kuyijenali i-Organization Science, lapho abeluleki be-Boston Consulting Group abangu-758 baphothula imisebenzi yangempela, abanye besiza isisizi se-AI ekhiqizayo, abanye bengasisizi. Emisebenzini eminingi iqembu elisebenzisa i-AI lasebenza ngesivinini nangezinga eliphezulu, kodwa emsebenzini owodwa owedlula amakhono ale thuluzi, amaphesenti angu-70.6 kuphela abasebenzisi i-AI abafinyelele impendulo eyiqiniso, kumelene namaphesenti angu-84.5 kwabasebenze bebodwa, kanti abahloli ababengayazi impendulo eyiqiniso bathe iziphakamiso ezingalungile ezisizwe yi-AI zazinethonya elilinganiselwa nalelo leziphakamiso eziyiqiniso.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kwinsika ka-Wits AHEAD ephathelene ne-AI, ikhono labathweswe iziqu, ukuqasheka kanye noguquko olunobulungiswa, lokhu okutholakele kukhombisa ukuthi umsebenzi osizwe yi-AI ongalungile kodwa ozethembile ungabukeka unethonya njengomsebenzi oyiqiniso, okusho ukuthi ikhono abathweswe iziqu abalidinga kakhulu ngaphambi kokungena emsebenzini kungukwahlulela kochwepheshe, hhayi ukwazi i-AI kuphela.

University World News · Established higher education press, commentary citing a peer-reviewed field experiment

entry.title: UNESCO and Codemao's AI coding drive reaches more African classrooms
entry.summary:
I-UNESCO kanye nesosha lokuhlela izinhlelo zekhompuyutha laseShayina, i-Codemao, bathi uhlelo lwabo olubambisene lokufundisa intsha ukubhala amakhodi luya phambili e-Afrika. Isigaba sesibili, esizoqhubeka kuze kube ngu-2030, sesifundise othisha abangu-200 eRiphabhuliki yaseCongo, eKenya, eNamibia naseThailand, okungu-45% kwabo abesifazane, futhi iKenya inikezwe ama-tablet angu-200 ezikoleni eziphakeme ezincane ezingu-20.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kwinsika ka-Wits AHEAD ephathelene ne-AI kanye nokuhlaziya kwedatha kuzifundo ze-STEM kanye nemfundo yothisha, lolu hlelo lukhombisa isibonelo sokwakha amakhono e-AI nokubhala amakhodi kothisha emazweni aseNingizimu Yomhlaba, kunikwa ingqalasizinda kwabesifazane.

Xinhua (New China TV) · Major international news agency, video report

entry.title: PISA 2025 finds AI chatbot use split with student learning outcomes
entry.summary:
Uhlolovivinyo lwe-PISA 2025 lwe-OECD, okuwulokuqala oluhlola ukusetshenziswa kwe-AI, luhlolwe abafundi abangaphezu kuka-760,000 abaneminyaka engu-15 emazweni angu-91. Luthole ukuthi ukuncika kakhulu kuma-chatbot e-AI ukubhala umsebenzi wesikole kuhlobene namamaki aphansi kwisayensi, kuyilapho ukusetshenziswa okulinganiselwe futhi okuqondiswayo kukhombisa amaphethini ahlukile futhi amahle kakhudlwana; amamaki okufunda nezibalo nawo awele kakhulu emazweni e-OECD eminyakeni eyishumi edlule.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kwinsika ka-Wits AHEAD ephathelene ne-AI ekhiqizayo kwimfundo ephakeme, ukufundisa, ukuhlola kanye nobuqotho basemfundweni, lokhu kuyisibonakaliso sokuqala sendlela amakhono e-AI abafundi abaza kuwo enyuvesi azoba yiwo, nendlela enyuvesi ezodinga ukufundisa nokuhlola ngayo.

OECD (via Newsweek) · Intergovernmental body's flagship international assessment, reported by established press

entry.title: Understanding ethical dimensions of AI in higher education: insights from faculty members and students
entry.summary:
Ucwaningo olusebenzise izindlela ezihlanganisiwe lwabuza abafundi abangu-971 kanye nabasebenzi bezemfundo abangu-135, kwabe sekuxoxiswana nabafundi abangu-23 nothisha abangu-14, mayelana nokuziphatha nge-AI kwimfundo ephakeme. Amaqembu womabili avumelana ngokubanzi ukuthi i-AI kufanele isetshenziswe ngendlela enesibopho, kodwa imibono yehlukene: othisha bagcizelela izimiso zokuziphatha kodwa bathi izikhungo zabo zisalokhu zintula imihlahlandlela, kuyilapho abafundi bathola i-AI iwusizo ekufundeni kodwa bengaqiniseki ukuthi isibopho sabo siya kuphi.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kwinsika ka-Wits AHEAD ephathelene ne-AI enokuzibophezela, ukuziphatha, ukulingana kanye nenqubomgomo, izincomo zocwaningo, ukuqeqeshwa kothisha, izifundo zokuziphatha ezizimele kanye nemihlahlandlela ecacile yezikhungo, zinikeza uhlu olusebenzisekayo kuzikhungo ezisengenayo inqubomgomo esemthethweni yokuziphatha nge-AI.

International Journal of Educational Technology in Higher Education · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: From AI literacy to action: South Africa charts a path forward for teacher education
entry.summary:
UMnyango Wezemfundo Ephakeme NokuQeqeshwa waseNingizimu Afrika kanye ne-Commonwealth of Learning babambe umhlangano kazwelonke wezinsuku ezimbili ophathelene ne-AI kwimfundo yothisha, enkampasini ye-Future Africa yeNyuvesi yasePitoli. Othisha, abenzi benqubomgomo nabaholi bohlelo bavumelana ngendlela yenqubomgomo kazwelonke eguquguqekayo esekelwe ezinqubomgomweni, baphinde basungula ithimba lomsebenzi likazwelonke, imiphumela yomhlangano ihloswe ukufaka esivivinyweni esiqhubekayo seMinimum Requirements for Teacher Education Qualifications, abahlanganyeli baphawula ukuthi lesi sivivinyo manje asikhulumi ngalutho mayelana ne-i-AI.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kwinsika ka-Wits AHEAD ephathelene ne-AI nokuhlaziywa kwedatha ku-STEM nemfundo yothisha, lokhu kukhombisa inqubo ecacile, eholwa nguhulumeni, eguqula ulwazi lwe-i-AI kwinqubomgomo kazwelonke yeziqu kuhlelo lwemfundo yothisha yaseNingizimu Afrika.

Commonwealth of Learning · Intergovernmental organisation report on a national government workshop

entry.title: Supporting cost-effective AI adoption in education
entry.summary:
IBhange Lomhlaba likhiphe iphepha locwaningo elithi Costing AI Use in Education in Low- and Middle-Income Countries, kanye nokubhaliwe kwebhulogi elichaza indlela amaminisitala emfundo okufanele ahlele ngayo isabelomali se-i-AI. Liphakamisa ukuthi kuqalwe ngamathuluzi asiza othisha, njengokuhlela izifundo nokunikeza impendulo, kunokuthi i-AI isakazwe kubafundi bonke ngaso sinye isikhathi, ukuthi izindleko ze-AI ziqhathaniswe nezindleko zamanje zokwandisa ukufundisa okujwayelekile, kanye nokusetshenziswa kwamadivayisi nezinethiwekhi zeselula ezivele zikhona ezikoleni. IBhange Lomhlaba likala ukuthi ukufinyelela kumgomo wentuthuko osimeme wemfundo e-Afrika esezansi kweSahara kuzodinga ngaphezu kwalokho u-6.4 bhiliyoni wamaDola e-US ngonyaka wothisha bamabanga aphansi kanye no-38.7 bhiliyoni wamaDola ngonyaka wothisha bamabanga aphezulu ngo-2030.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kwinsika ka-Wits AHEAD ephathelene nokuhlaziywa kwedatha nokusiza izinqumo kuhlelo lwemfundo, lombiko unikeza amaminisitala nezikhungo emazweni aseNingizimu Yomhlaba uhlaka olucacile, olunezindleko ezibaliwe, lokunquma ukuthi isabelomali se-i-AI kwimfundo sizosiza kakhulu kuphi.

World Bank · Intergovernmental body blog, summarising a World Bank working paper

entry.title: Grappling with "homework scams", US universities shun AI detectors
entry.summary:
Umbiko we-AFP owatshalwa i-eNCA uchaza indlela iYale, iCornell kanye ne-University of Wisconsin-Madison ezinqabela noma ezivimbela abasebenzi babo ukusebenzisa isofthiwe yokubona i-AI njengobufakazi bokukhwabanisa, ngemuva kokuba ucwaningo lutholile ukuthi lezi zinsiza azithembekile futhi zivame ukuphawula ngamphumela angamanga, kuhlanganise nabo abangasiwo abakhulumi bemvelo besiNgisi. Uthisha wezifundo zemvelo wase-Wisconsin-Madison, owafihla umyalo kumsebenzi, wabamba abafundi abangu-60 kwabangu-350 besebenzisa i-AI bengabonwa yizinhlolo ezijwayelekile, futhi usengaguqukela ekuhlolweni ngomlomo nezinkulumo-mpikiswano zevidiyo kunoe-eyise; ucwaningo lwe-American Association of Colleges and Universities ne-Elon University luthole ukuthi amaphesenti angu-95 othisha esaba ukuncika ngokweqile kwabafundi ku-AI.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: I-AI ekhiqizayo emfundweni ephakeme, ikakhulukazi ukuhlolwa nobuqotho bezemfundo, kuyinsika yokuqala ye-Wits AHEAD, futhi lokhu kuhoxa kwisofthiwe yokubona i-AI emanyuvesi ahamba phambili kuyisikhombiso esiqondile, esisebenzisekayo sokuthi iqembu kufanele licebise ngokuguqula ukuhlolwa kunokuba kubonwe i-AI njengempendulo yokusetshenziswa kabi kwayo.

AFP (via eNCA) · Established press (wire service report)

entry.title: Global Employment Trends for Youth 2026: Back to the Future
entry.summary:
Umbiko we-International Labour Organization, i-Global Employment Trends for Youth 2026, uthole ukuthi izinga lokuntula umsebenzi kwentsha emhlabeni wenyuka lafika ku-12.4% ngonyaka we-2025, kushiya cishe izigidi ezingu-67 zentsha eminyakeni ewu-15 kuya ku-24 ingasebenzi, kuyilapho cishe oyodwa kwabahlanu bentsha, abalinganiselwa ezigidini ezingu-257, bengekho emsebenzini, ezifundweni noma ekuqeqeshweni. Umbiko ulinganisela ukuthi amaphesenti angu-6.1 emisebenzi ephethwe yintsha eminyakeni ewu-15 kuya ku-29 asengcupheni enkulu yokuthathelwa indawo ngemisebenzi ye-AI, ivame kube imisebenzi yokubhala namahhovisi eyake incipha kakade kubasebenzi abasha, futhi ukhuthaza indlela yokulawula i-AI nobuchwepheshe egcizelela umuntu, ihambisana nokusekelwa okwengeziwe ukuya emsebenzini ohloniphekile.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ukuqasheka kwabathweswe iziqu nokuguquka okunobulungiswa, kuhlanganise indlela i-AI eguqula ngayo imisebenzi engenisayo, kuyinsika yesine ye-Wits AHEAD, futhi lokhu okutholakele kulombiko wamazwe ngamazwe, ukuthi imisebenzi yokubhala namahhovisi, evame kube isinyathelo sokuqala kwabathweswe iziqu, isengcupheni enkulu kakhulu ye-AI, kunika iqembu isikali esiqondile nesisemhlabeni wonke somsebenzi walo mayelana ne-AI nokuqasheka kwabathweswe iziqu eNingizimu Yomhlaba.

International Labour Organization · Intergovernmental body report

entry.title: Generative AI use and misuse call for assessment reform in higher education
entry.summary:
Ucwaningo olushicilelwe kuyijenali ehlolwa ontanga, i-Science, luphenye abafundi abangaphezu kuka-95,000 emanyuvesi angu-20 amakhulu kahulumeni aseMelika oncike kucwaningo, ngonyaka wezifundo wezi-2023-24. Luthole ukuthi amaphesenti angu-37 abafundi asebenzisa i-AI ekhiqizayo okungenani kanye ngenyanga emisebenzini, futhi ababhali balinganisela ukuthi cishe amaphesenti angu-9 ayisebenzisa ukukhohlisa, lokhu kukhuphuka kufika ku-26% kubasebenzisi bansuku zonke; ukusetshenziswa nokukhohlisa kwahluka ngokubanzi ngokuya ngomkhakha. Ababhali bancoma ushintsho lokuhlolwa oluhambisana nomkhakha ngamunye kunokuvala konke noma uhlelo lokubona i-AI enyuvesi yonke.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: I-AI ekhiqizayo emfundweni ephakeme, ikakhulukazi ukuhlolwa nobuqotho bezemfundo, kuyinsika yokuqala ye-Wits AHEAD, futhi lokhu okutholakele kulolu cwaningo olukhulu, ukuthi ukusetshenziswa kabi kwehluka ngokomkhakha hhayi ngokufanayo, kunika iqembu ubufakazi obuqondile bokuklama ushintsho lokuhlolwa ngomkhakha ngamunye, kunoshintsho olubanzi.

Science · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: UCT summit puts AI, inequality and future of universities in spotlight
entry.summary:
Ingqungquthela Yomhlaba Yezemfundo Ephakeme ye-Times Higher Education ivuliwe e-University of Cape Town ngomhla ka-30 kuMandulo 2026, okuba kokuqala ukuba ingqungquthela le ibanjwe e-Afrika. Abaholi bezemfundo ephakeme, abafundisi kanye nenzimeli zombuso abalinganiselwa ku-600 abavela emazweni angaphezu kuka-60 babambe iqhaza; iPhini loMqashi uSolwazi Mosa Moshabela wathi ikusasa lenyuvesi ngeke lincike nje ekwamukeleni ubuchwepheshe, kuyilapho uNgqongqoshe Wezemfundo Ephakeme, uButi Manamela, ebiza ukuba i-AI yandise ukufinyelela emfundweni, kusekelwa ukuqondisiswa okubanzi kwe-AI nokufinyelela okungcono kubuchwepheshe. I-UCT isiyeke ukuthembela kuhlelo lokuhlonza i-AI, esikhundleni salokho yakha uhlaka lwayo olwengamela indlela abafundi nabasebenzi abasebenzisa ngayo i-AI ekhiqizayo.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ukufinyelela ngokulinganayo ku-AI ekhiqizayo kwimfundo ephakeme kuyinsika yokuqala kwezinsika eziyisithupha ze-Wits AHEAD, futhi uNgqongqoshe ebeka ukuqondisiswa kwe-AI, hhayi uhlelo lokuhlonza, njengesimo sokufinyelela okulinganayo, kuhambisana nqo nomsebenzi weqembu wenqubomgomo nowokufundisa.

TimesLIVE · Established press

entry.title: Global Index on Responsible AI: 2026 Report
entry.summary:
I-Global Index on Responsible AI ka-2026, eshicilelwe yi-Global Center on AI Governance futhi yethulwa eGeneva ngoNtulikazi 2026, ihlole ukuphathwa kombuso emazweni ayi-135 isebenzisa amaphuzu edatha angaphezu kuka-68,000 aqoqwe phakathi kukaLwezi 2023 kuNcwaba 2025. Ithola ukuthi amazwe ayi-126 kwayi-135 anenqubomgomo noma uhlelo lukahulumeni okungenani olulodwa mayelana ne-AI enokuzibophezela, nokho lokhu kuzibophezela kuyivelakancane ukuba kube isivikelo esinamandla ngomthetho; ukuqondisiswa kwe-AI kuphakathi kwezinkomba eziphethe kahle, amazwe angu-71, okungu-53%, abika uhlaka olusebenza, kubhekwana namazwe ambalwa kakhulu anamabhodi okuqapha ezizimele noma izinhlelo zokubheka.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: I-AI enokuzibophezela, ukuziphatha okulungile, ukulingana nenqubomgomo kuyinsika yesithupha ye-Wits AHEAD, futhi okutholakele yile ndeks, ukuthi inqubomgomo yokuqondisiswa kwe-AI ihamba ngesivinini esisheshayo kunamaziko anamandla okuyiphoqelela, kuphawula ngqo igebe lokuphatha iqembu elizama ukulivala ngomsebenzi wenqubomgomo yalo yemfundo ephakeme eNingizimu Yomhlaba.

Global Center on AI Governance · Independent global governance research index

entry.title: Preparing future STEM educators: investigating artificial intelligence literacy among pre-service STEM teachers
entry.summary:
Ucwaningo olushicilelwe kuyijenali ehlolwa ontanga, i-STEM Education, luphenye ukuqondisiswa kwe-AI kothisha abaqeqeshwayo be-STEM abangu-541 esifundazweni sase-Lagos, eNigeria, abangu-345 abesifazane nabangu-196 abesilisa. Othisha babike izinga eliphezulu ngokuvamile lokuqondisiswa kwe-AI, futhi ulwazi nokuqonda kwabo nge-AI kwabikezela ngokubonakalayo indlela abasebenzisa ngayo kamuva; ucwaningo luphinde lwathola umehluko obonakalayo phakathi kobulili ekuqondisiseni kwe-AI, obeka kuqala abesilisa.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: I-AI nokuhlaziya kwidatha kwe-STEM nemfundo yothisha kuyinsika yesithathu ye-Wits AHEAD, futhi lona mehluko wobulili otholakele kothisha abaqeqeshwayo base-Lagos uphawula ngqo indlela izinhlelo zokuqeqesha othisha emazweni aseNingizimu Yomhlaba ezingahlela ngayo ukulungiselela kwazo i-AI.

entry.title: Keeping the learning real: an integrated approach to academic integrity in the age of AI
entry.summary:
I-Wonkhe nenkampani yokuhlola ukuziphatha kwabafundi i-Studiosity baphenyisisa inqubomgomo yamanyuvesi e-United Kingdom, baphinde babamba izingxoxo nabaholi bezikhungo nabafundi ngoSeptemba 2026, bagxila ebuqotho bezifundo ngesikhathi se-AI ekhiqizayo. Umbiko wabo, owakhishwa ngomhla ka-4 Okthoba 2026, uveza ukuthi izikhungo ziqala ukushiya indlela yokuqapha ukusetshenziswa kwe-AI ngamathuluzi okuyibona, zithatha indlela yokuqamba kabusha izindlela zokuhlola, ukufundisa ulwazi lokusebenzisa i-AI, nezindlela ezingajeziseki zokuqinisekisa ukuthi ukufunda kuyenzeka ngempela. Uphawula ukuthi uhlelo lobuqotho bezifundo lusengenawo ukuhlangana okuphelele, futhi abafundi basengabathembekile kulo, bengabaza ukuthi izikhungo zizowakholelwa amazwi abo mayelana nendlela abasebenzise ngayo i-AI.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kwinsika ka-Wits AHEAD ephathelene ne-AI ekhiqizayo kwimfundo ephakeme, ukufundisa, ukuhlola nobuqotho bezifundo, lona ngumbiko ocacile, waphezulu, wendlela ohlelo lwemfundo ephakeme olukhulu oluqamba kabusha ukuhlolwa esikhundleni sokuzama nje ukubona ukusetshenziswa kwe-AI, futhi unikeza uhlaka olusebenzayo lokuqondisa abasebenzi nabafundi.

Wonkhe / Studiosity · UK higher education policy platform report, based on institutional policy review and sector roundtables

entry.title: Digital solidification: learning analytics, the panopticon, and data coloniality in South African higher education
entry.summary:
USingh, we-University of Johannesburg, uphakamisa ukuthi ukuhlaziywa kokufunda kwabafundi kungasebenza njenge-digital panopticon, iso elihlala libukele, eliguqula izithiyo zesikhashana, njengokucima kwamandla kagesi noma ukuntuleka kwedatha yeselula, kube izimpawu zokusilela ezilandela umfundi unomphela, ngaphakathi kohlaka lobukoloni bedatha. Iphepha alithi ukuhlaziywa kokufunda akubi yingozi ngazo zonke izikhathi, kodwa liyaxwayisa ukuthi izimpawu ezingaphonswa inselelo noma zibuyekezwe zenza kakhulu izimo ezingalingani zeNingizimu Afrika zezinsiza nezolimi. Liphakamisa uhlaka olugxile ebulungisweni bomphakathi, olusekelwe ekuxolelweni kwedatha, ukucwaningwa kwama-algorithm okubandakanya abafundi, nokuqondwa kwezimpawu ngokulandela isimo njengesikhuthazo sosizo, hhayi isijeziso.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Lokhu kuyingxoxo ebuyekeziwe ngochwepheshe eqondile yaseNingizimu Afrika, mayelana namathuluzi okuhlaziya okubikezelayo asekujuleni kwensika ka-Wits AHEAD ye-AI nokuhlaziywa kwedatha okubikezelayo kuphumelelo labafundi, futhi inikeza insika yeqembu ephathelene ne-AI enokuzibophezela, ukwenza okuqondile nokulingana izivikelo ezisekelwe kucatshangelwa ngaphambi kokuncoma izinhlelo zesexwayiso sangaphambili.

entry.title: Helpful or harmful? Generative AI dependence, self-reported critical thinking disposition, and self-perceived employability among business students
entry.summary:
OShojaei nozakwabo baphenyisisa abafundi beziqu zokuqala bezamabhizinisi abangu-412 emanyuvesi amathathu e-Oman, mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwe-AI ekhiqizayo, ukuncika kuyo, ukucabanga okujulile, nokuzibona ngendlela yokuqasheka. Ukusetshenziswa okukhulu kwe-AI kwahlobana nokuzibona kuqashekile ngokuphezulu, kodwa ukuncika okukhulu ku-AI kwahlobana nokucabanga okujulile okuncane, futhi kwenza buthaka ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kokusetshenziswa kwe-AI nokuqasheka, kwaze kwaphelelwa ukubaluleka kwezibalo lapho ukuncika kuphakeme kakhulu. Ababhali baphetha ngokuthi izinzuzo zincike ekusebenziseni i-AI ngokucabangisisa nokuhlola okuyifezayo, hhayi esibalweni sokuyisebenzisa, nakuba indlela yocwaningo esekelwe emibikweni yabafundi ngokwabo, engabhekwanga isikhathi eside, ikhawulela ukusho ngqo isizathu nemiphumela.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Lokhu kukhuluma ngqo kwinsika ka-Wits AHEAD ephathelene ne-AI, ikhono labathweswe iziqu nokuqasheka, ibonisa ukuthi ukuncika ku-AI ngaphandle kokuhlaziya kungaphazamisa ikhono elifiselwa abaqashi, isixwayiso esifaneleka ohlelweni lokuqasheka emazweni aseNingizimu Yomhlaba.

Frontiers in Education · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Assessment practices resistant to inappropriate AI use in Open Distance eLearning: insights from Zimbabwe Open University
entry.summary:
OMagwa noZongozzi, be-University of South Africa, baxoxisana nothisha, abafundi kanye nomxhumanisi wesiqinisekiso sekhwalithi enkampasini yeMasvingo yase-Zimbabwe Open University, bebuza ukuthi yiluphi uhlobo lokuhlolwa olumelana nokusetshenziswa okungafanele kwe-AI ekhiqizayo. Bathola ukuthi ukuhlolwa okusekelwe ekwenzeni, ukucabangisisa, ukuhlolwa ngomlomo, kanye nokuhlolwa kokufunda okubukwa eduze, kwabonakala kungukuhlolwa okunzima ukukuqeda ngokungathembeki kusetshenziswa i-AI, kodwa lokhu kuphakamisa ukukhathazeka ngomthwalo womsebenzi wothisha nangosayizi wekilasi. Ababhali baxwayisa ukuthi okutholakele kusuka enkampasini eyodwa yesifunda akungeniswa esivivinyeni sayo yonke isikhungo noma ukufunda okuqhutshwa ukusuka kude ngokubanzi.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Lokhu kunikeza umbono wamazwe aseNingizimu Yomhlaba, ophathelene nokufunda okuqhutshwa ukusuka kude, mayelana nokuqamba kabusha ukuhlolwa ukumelana nokusetshenziswa okungafanele kwe-AI ekhiqizayo kwinsika ka-Wits AHEAD yeAI ekhiqizayo kwimfundo ephakeme, futhi kufaneleka ngqo nohlelo lokufunda okuqhutshwa ukusuka kude kuleli lizwekazi.

entry.title: Automated software scoring of senior school certificate examination mathematical items in economics using a contextual similarity model
entry.summary:
OOlaoye, Owolabi noOlaoye bahlola uhlelo lwekhompyutha olwakha amamaki ngokuzenzakalelayo emibuzweni yezibalo ehlobene ne-Economics yamabanga aphakeme esifundeni esisentshonalanga neningizimu yeNigeria, basebenzisa isampula labafundi abangu-1,008 kusukela enanini labangenele isivivinyo abacishe babe-275,000. Amamaki aphuma kuhlelo avumelana kakhulu nawaphuma kubahloli abayishumi nambili abaqeqeshiwe, ngokuhlobana okuphakeme okukalwa ngokuhlanganisa, okungu-0.863. Ababhali baphawula ukuthi uvivinyo lwaluphathelene nemibuzo emibili kuphela nokuthi umhloli ngamunye wahlola imiqulu engu-84 kuphela, ngakho kusadingeka ukuqinisekiswa okwengeziwe ngaphambi kokuthi lusetshenziswe kabanzi kuzivivinyo ezifana neWAEC, iNECO neNABTEB.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Lokhu kuyisibonelo esiqondile, esihlobene ne-STEM, sokusetshenziswa kokuhlaziya ukuhlolwa esivivinywe kuzinga lokuzwelonke lesivivinyo eNtshonalanga Afrika, kufaneleka ngqo kwinsika ka-Wits AHEAD yeAI nokuhlaziywa kwedatha ku-STEM kanye nezinhlelo zemfundo ezinkulu.

entry.title: Six publishers agree to feed 20 million research papers to AI agents, in a pay-per-use deal
entry.summary:
Abashicileli bezincwadi zocwaningo abayisithupha, kuhlanganise i-Sage, i-BMJ Group kanye ne-Institute of Physics, bavumelene ukuvumela inkampani entsha yaseSweden i-Redpine ukuthi inikeze ama-ejenti we-AI ukufinyelela emaphepheni acwaningwe ngontanga angaphezu kwezigidi ezingu-20, ngesikhathi sangempela, kusho i-Times Higher Education ngomhla zi-6 kuMfumfu 2026. Lesi sivumelwano sokukhokha ngokusetshenziswa sikhokhela abashicileli kanye nababhali njalo uma uhlelo lwe-AI lusebenzisa umsebenzi wabo, kuhlanganise amajenali emkhakheni wezempilo, isayensi yokuphila nesayensi yemvelo.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kusinsika ka-Wits AHEAD ye-AI enokuzibophezela, ukuziphatha okulungile, ukulingana kanye nenqubomgomo, lesi sivumelwano siwuvivinyo wokuqala wendlela ukushicilelwa kocwaningo okungagcina i-AI isekelwe kocwaningo oluqinisekisiwe kunokuqagela, kuyilapho kulungiswa ukuthi ubani okhokhelwa uma umshini, hhayi umfundi, ewucaphuna umsebenzi.

entry.title: Mystery-shopper study finds university enquiry replies 'costing enrolments', as ChatGPT outperforms
entry.summary:
Ucwaningo lohlobo lwe-mystery shopper olwenziwe emanyuvesi angu-33 e-United Kingdom nangu-30 e-Australia, oluqhutshwe yinkampani yezeluleko i-Edified kanye nenkampani yokuqasha abafundi i-UniQuest, futhi olubikwe yi-Times Higher Education ngomhla zi-1 kuMfumfu 2026, luthole ukuthi amaphesenti angu-37 kuphela emibuzweni engaba-700 yabafundi abafisa ukubhalisa athole impendulo eyabakhuthazayo ukuqhubeka nokuxhumana. Amaphesenti angu-15 emibuzo awatholakalelwa impendulo nhlobo, futhi izimpendulo ze-ChatGPT zathola amamaki aphezulu ngokushesha, ngokuphelele kanye nokuncenga kunezimpendulo zamanyuvesi uqobo.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kusinsika ka-Wits AHEAD yokuhlaziywa kwedatha ohlelweni lwezemfundo nasekuthathweni kwezinqumo, lolu cwaningo luyisikhumbuzo esiqondile sokuthi izikhungo eziqoqa idatha mayelana nabafundi abafisa ukubhalisa kudingeka futhi zisebenzise lolu lwazi, njengoba cishe ababili kwabathathu babafundi abafisa ukubhalisa ocwaningweni basala bengakholwa yimpendulo yomuntu, ekwazi ukunqotshwa yi-AI ephothwe kahle.

Times Higher Education · Established press (Times Higher Education), citing a study by Edified and UniQuest

entry.title: How computer-science students actually use large language models varies sharply by task, study finds
entry.summary:
Iphepha locwaningo elifakwe ku-arXiv ngomhla zi-1 kuMfumfu 2026 lihlaziya indlela abafundi beziqu zokuqala abangu-211 abasebenzisa ngayo ama-LLM emamojuli ayisikhombisa esifundweni sokuxazulula izinkinga kwisayensi yekhompyutha. Abafundi basebenzisa lawa mathuluzi kakhulu emisebenzini ye-algorithms nokuthuthukiswa kwamawebhusayithi, futhi kancane kakhulu emisebenzini yobunjiniyela bezinhlelo zokusebenza, bevame ukuwabheka njengabasizi okufanele bahlolwe, hhayi njengamagunya okuwathemba ngokuphelele, baqinisekisa imiphumela ngokuzivivinya emisebenzini enesakhiwo esicacile, futhi basesha ku-inthanethi emisebenzini evulekile.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kusinsika ka-Wits AHEAD ye-AI ekhiqizayo kwimfundo ephakeme, lokhu okutholakele, ukuthi indlela abafundi abaqinisekisa ngayo imiphumela iguquka ngokuya ngomsebenzi, hhayi ngomfundi kuphela, kuwuphawu oluqondile lokuthi ubuqotho bezemfundo nokuklanywa kokuhlolwa kudinga kuguquke umsebenzi ngomsebenzi.
